name: Pumpkaboo
description: The Pumpkin Pokémon. The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

abilities.name: Recogida
abilities.description: Si un oponente consume un objeto equipado durante el combate, este Pokémon obtiene una copia de dicho objeto, siempre que no tenga actualmente ningún objeto equipado.

abilities.name: Cacheo
abilities.description: Cuando este Pokémon entra en combate, un objeto equipado por un oponente es revelado, si tiene alguno.

abilities.name: Insomnio
abilities.description: Este Pokémon es inmune a quedarse dormido.

specialAbilityText: Pumpkaboo come in a variety of sizes: Small, Average, Large, and Supersize (All considered "Small" for D&D). The stat block above is for its Small variety. For each size above Small, decrease its DEX by -1 and raise its CON by +1.
